shadows.name: specimen-ambient
shadows.purpose: Diffuse lift for the small code-drawn identity specimen in the first viewport.

shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for the generator and finished report sheets from the pale-blue work surface.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Short feedback for buttons, chips, swatch copy affordances, and native disclosure chevrons.

motion.name: progress-spin
motion.purpose: Running-state cue for generation and sample loading.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { scroll-behavior: auto; animation: none; transition: none; }
motion.purpose: Removes motion and changes report scrolling to immediate movement for motion-sensitive users.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Adds vertical air to the landing intro without changing its order.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Contracts the report rail and evidence grids for medium screens.

breakpoints.name: portrait
breakpoints.purpose: Stacks the query controls, hides the specimen, and changes report navigation to horizontal scrolling.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single cobalt action for starting a guide or the next primary handoff step.
components.html: <button class='ds-btn-primary' type='button'>Generate guide <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'><path d='M5 12h14'></path><path d='m12 5 7 7-7 7'></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 21px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--cobalt); color: var(--paper); font: 750 13px/1.6 Manrope Variable, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .6; }

components.name: Query Input
components.description: The primary website-or-company field with a native input and its cobalt generate action.
components.css: .ds-query { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #a9b9d7; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); } .ds-query:focus-within { border-color: var(--cobalt); outline: 2px solid #2856d921; } .ds-query-icon { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-left: 12px; fill: none; stroke: #5f77a1; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-query input { flex: 1; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.6 Manrope Variable, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-query input::placeholder { color: #677590; opacity: 1; } .ds-query button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 21px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--cobalt); color: var(--paper); font: 750 13px/1.6 Manrope Variable, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-query button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-query button:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark); } .ds-query input:focus-visible, .ds-query button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-query { position: relative; flex-wrap: wrap; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0; gap: 0; } .ds-query-icon { position: absolute; margin: 15px 0 0 12px; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-query input { flex: auto; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 40px; border: 1px solid #a9b9d7; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-query button { width: 100%; margin-top: 9px; } }

components.name: Session Disclosure
components.description: A native details control for the optional session key and its storage explanation.
components.html:
Session keyOptional

Kept in this tab’s session and sent only with your generate request.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 13px; color: var(--ink); font-family: Manrope Variable, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; width: fit-content; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 650; } .ds-disclosure summary span { margin-left: 5px; } .ds-disclosure summary > svg:first-child { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-disclosure .ds-chevron { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-disclosure[open] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-disclosure-content { max-width: 650px; padding: 17px 0 5px; } .ds-disclosure-content label { display: block; margin-bottom: 9px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-disclosure-content input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px/1.6 Manrope Variable, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure-content input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-disclosure-content p { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Report Navigation
components.description: The document rail that becomes a horizontally scrollable native navigation on portrait screens.
components.css: .ds-report-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-report-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.6 Manrope Variable, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-report-nav a:hover { color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-report-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-report-nav svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-report-nav { flex-direction: row; gap: 15px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 3px; } .ds-report-nav a { font-size: 12px; } .ds-report-nav a svg { display: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Crestline is a production jacket for turning a public website into a usable brand handoff. Cobalt leads the shell, a pale-blue work surface keeps the page open, and white report sheets give the sourced guide a physical place to land. The voice is clear, practical, and visibly accountable to evidence: every logo, colour, typeface, quote, and call can be followed back to a source.

The interface moves in the same order as the work: enter a company or website, watch Resolve → Search → Fetch → Agent → Compose, inspect a readable guide, then download JSON or PDF. Manrope Variable gives the whole system sturdy rounded details without making the report feel soft. The small identity specimen is code-drawn geometry, while external logos stay what they are in the product: remote evidence previews.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt production-jacket shell over a pale-blue work surface.
White, lightly lifted report sheets with ink-blue document hierarchy.
Source-first labels, methods, URLs, endpoint states, and native disclosures.
Compact desktop density that becomes a stacked portrait workbench without losing the handoff order.

rules.name: The Evidence Chain Rule
rules.body: Treat the interface as a traceable handoff: visual and verbal claims retain their source link and method, and recorded reports remain visibly distinct from live runs.

rules.name: The Cobalt Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep cobalt concentrated on the shell, primary action, active state, and meaningful links. Extracted brand colours belong to the report content and must not be guessed or recoloured into the product palette.

rules.name: The Document Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Headings carry the report; metadata recedes but remains readable. Do not make source evidence smaller than the final 12px evidence scale merely to fit more content.

rules.name: The Handoff Order Rule
rules.body: Preserve the sequence query → live examples → optional session key → recorded reports → generated report. On portrait screens, stack the query controls and let report navigation scroll rather than shrinking labels into illegibility.

rules.name: The Paper Sheet Rule
rules.body: Use elevation to identify a working surface or finished report, not to decorate every control. Chips, dividers, swatches, and native disclosures stay mostly flat.

dos: Do use the frontmatter cobalt, ink, pale-blue, paper, and hairline roles before introducing another product colour.
Do keep every extracted visual or verbal claim attached to its source URL and method.
Do preserve the recorded/live distinction, endpoint history, and Fetch evidence when Agent observation is unavailable.
Do use native buttons, links, details, and summary controls with the visible focus treatment and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the report hierarchy readable at the final 12px evidence scale, including call-history metadata and purposes.
Do draw the identity specimen from geometry and use remote logos only as evidence previews.
donts: Don't invent a colour, font, logo, or tagline when the captured evidence does not provide one.
Don't ship remote logo previews as raster brand assets, or replace the code-drawn specimen with a shipping raster file.
Don't turn the pale-blue work surface into a warm editorial paper, gradient field, or decorative pattern.
Don't add borrowed ornament, side stripes, oversized shadows, or extra display faces to the production-jacket shell.
Don't collapse the portrait report nav into clipped labels or remove the stacked portrait query behavior.
Don't treat a recorded sample as a live run, or treat an Agent failure as a reason to discard usable Fetch evidence.
